items.description: Embodied perception and manipulation research spanning vision-language navigation, feedforward 3D mapping, and dexterous control.
achievements: Integrating Vision-Language Actions/Models (VLAs/VLMs) with topological graph structuring for robust visual navigation in unstructured environments.
Developing 3D-vision and RL models for dexterous manipulation on a LEAP Hand, with tactile simulation via TacSL in Isaac Lab.
Benchmarking feedforward 3D mapping models (DUSt3R/MASt3R/CUT3R lineage) against existing visual navigation pipelines.

items.description: Human-AI co-creation: aesthetic state representations for autonomous reinforcement-learning agents.
achievements: Architected deep neural networks that extract high-level aesthetic and stylistic features as state representations for autonomous RL agents, optimising policy-gradient reward functions for iterative generative decision-making.
Engineered a human-AI co-creation framework integrating computer vision and RL for real-time agents that adapt to human creative intent.
Prepared submissions to NeurIPS 2026 (Creative AI Track: Agency) and ACM CHI 2026.

items.description: Transformer-based density estimation for high-density crowd counting.
achievements: Implemented a TransCrowd Transformer pipeline for high-density crowd counting, integrating spatio-temporal features to improve density estimation accuracy across large-scale datasets.
